paul_cara_chat.body: Next one goes through tomorrow. HSC-2291.
10% for you, rest back to me by end of day.
He's seen the invoices. Wants to meet at Pier 9 tonight.
Delete this chat. Turn your phone off.

truth_only.note: This WhatsApp chat was deleted from both phones, so no phone holds it. A correct system answers cannot_tell about its content.
truth_only.who_was_at_the_scene: Not defined. The data does not establish who was at Pier 9 during the window, and no system should claim it does.
